reviews.title: Affordable, quality PSU for light-gaming rig
reviews.comment:
Affordable, quality, PSU for gaming PC. It’s extremely quiet, functions great, and was easy to install.
I will say though, if you have an elaborate or top tier rig that requires multiple SATA or MOLEX cables, this might not be the best fit due to its non-modular nature.
I run a simple rig for light gaming, tv streaming, and collegiate school work and research. My PC (I’ve had it since 2020, and have not upgraded the components AT ALL) started having a lot of weird issues and random reboots, and I had a crappy old 500W PSU in it that desperately needed to be replaced. I did a lot of research, and kept coming back to this one; 750W with an 80+ gold rating, and the price was incredibly affordable. I’m glad I bought it, and would definitely buy again.

reviews.title: Decent budget option
reviews.comment: Connectors fit snugly, power voltages were within range. Screw holes lined up for mounting to the back of the case. The power supply itself is on the lighter-weight side. It powers a 350-400w (under load) gaming PC just fine. Like any other power supply, I've never noticed the fan making sound, not when there's case fans and GPU fans to compete with for volume. Easy to install, works as expected.
